Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
I can see that cards like research and developement
define the new term for the game "research area", but such definition seems
missing in the new rulebook.
Is that a a mistake or just another case of cards defining some rules/terms
of their own,
without any further reference in the rulebook ?

thanks in advance

Emiliano, NC Italy

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:


The definition of the Research Area is given on the Heirs to the
Blood's page:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=Checklist_HeirsToTheBlood

Research Area: Some cards may move cards to a special staging area
called the research area. The cards in your research area are face
down and out of play; they can be affected only by cards and effects
that say so explicitly.
